posts.title: How to Dye Your Hair at Home Like a Pro?
posts.author: Color Fluent
posts.brief: Many people think coloring their hair at home is risky, messy, and hard work to do., but if you choose the right approach, it's super-easy and cost-effective.

content.value:
Many people think coloring their hair at home is risky, messy, and hard work to do., but if you choose the right approach, it's super-easy and cost-effective.

Taking your hair to the salon can be quite expensive, so dyeing it yourself can give you a brand-new look without costing a lot. Once you know how to dye hair, it's not as difficult as it seems.

First of all, do these steps before you jump into dying your hair:
Wash your hair but not right before coloring it!
It's best practice to wash your hair 24-48 hours before dying the hair
Choose your preferred color!
While choosing the color, keep in mind that your current hair color might affect the final result, and choose wisely.
Wrap a towel around your shoulders or wear a color cape!
In order to prevent your clothes and house get color stains make sure to wear protection and keep away from the bright fabrics that might be affected.
Brush your hair carefully!
Any knots or messiness in your hair can end at the cost of not dyeing some parts of them. So better to make sure that your hair is neat and brushed.
Cover your hairline, neck, and ears with Vaseline!
In order to prevent your skin, get colored, it's better to coat it with some oil-based protections.
Put on some plastic gloves!
You don't want your hands to get messed up and turn black or God forbids purple! Put on some gloves so that color won't get to your hands and fingers.
Now that everything is ready, let's dye our hair!
What are the different ways to dye our hair?
When you want to dye your hair at home you have 3 main different methods to do so:

1. Use of a brush and a bowl of color formula
2. Using a bottle and applying with hands
3. Using Color Fluent
How to dye your hair using a brush?

Take a plastic bowl and mix the color ingredients into it using the color brush or a plastic stirrer. Then you divide your hair into small sections. Now, using a color brush, take a small amount of color from inside the bowl and apply it on thin layers of hair to make sure that the entire surface is covered. Continue doing so till all your hair is dyed.

Cover your hair with a plastic hat and leave it for 30-45 minutes and then wash it with medium-heated water and no shampoo. You can use a hair mask or conditioner.
How to dye your hair using a bottle of color formula?

This method's pretty easy. After mixing the coloring ingredients, put them into a plastic bottle like in the image below. Like the previous method, you separate your hair into sections. Now apply a small portion of color on a thin layer of your hair and use your hands to cover the whole layer. After doing so for all your hair leave it to rest and wash it just like what we've said about the latest method.
/img/p1-img2.jpeg
How to dye your hair using Color Fluent?

While using Color Fluent, dying your hair is the easiest task ever. You not only need to be careful about the color you choose but all the messiness you might be concerned with fades away.

First, you can get help from the color fluent app to determine which color suits you and your current hair the best. Then the app will let you know the formula you have to use for getting the aforementioned result. Then you can fill the container of the Color Fluent brush with the mixture and start brushing your hair just as you do every day – of course, you better follow the constructions like first brushing the roots of the hair and then the rest of it.

Easy-peasy!

The rest is just like other methods. You need to leave your hair for 30-45 minutes so that the color gets into the hair pigments. And in the end, just wash your hair very gently and use some conditioner or hair protection mask.

If you have any questions regarding coloring your hair, feel free and ask our experts for their professional opinion. We're here to help you glow!

posts.title: Ten Common Mistakes while Dyeing Your Hair
posts.author: Color Fluent
posts.brief: Is coloring your hair at home on your list of things to do? Learn how to color your hair without ruining it by avoiding these common mistakes.

content.value:
Is coloring your hair at home on your list of things to do? Learn how to color your hair without ruining it by avoiding these common mistakes.

Here is the list of what you should avoid while dying your hair at home:

1. Washing Your Hair Before Dyeing
2. Picking the Wrong Hair Color
3. Using an Inappropriate Developer
4. Mixing Colors Based on Guess
5. Skipped Strand & Patch Test
6. Using Wrong Dyeing Tools
7. Applying the Formula in the Wrong Way
8. Miscount the Processing Time
9. Too Much Rinsing after Dying
10. Skip Post Treatment Process
Now let's dig deeper into each one of these mistakes and see how they might lead to a disaster.
1. Washing Your Hair Before Dyeing

It is not a good idea to shampoo your hair right before dying it. It's less likely to cause irritation to the scalp if your hair is left unwashed for 1-2 days before dying, and color pigment accumulates more efficiently.
2. Picking the Wrong Hair Color

Choosing a semi-permanent or temporary professional color is a good starting point if you're new to dyeing. In case you make a mistake, these colors make it much easier to recover from it.

It is also essential to choose the right shade. The best hair dye for your first time is one that is no more than two shades darker or lighter than your natural hair color. In case of doubt, choose the lighter shade.
3. Using Inappropriate Developer

It is also common to choose the wrong developer, either from another brand or series. Using the right developer concentration is crucial for achieving the best results. Developers with a 6% concentration are the most commonly used and versatile. Dyeing, lightning, and gray coverage can all be accomplished with this product.
4. Mixing Colors Based on Guess
Never do the mixing based on your guess or eye estimation. Always follow the instructions mentioned in the product's box or consult with a professional beforehand.
5. Skipped Strand & Patch Test

Nobody wants to get allergies and end up in ER just because of coloring their hair. So do a small test 48 hours before dying your hair on a very small part of your skin so to make sure you don't have any sort of allergies. Also, to prevent any disastrous hair color do a bit of testing on a few strands of your hair to ensure the final result.
6. Using Wrong Dyeing Tools

By choosing inappropriate tools, you can also spoil your coloring results. You should always use dyeing tools that are non-metallic. A metal bowl could cause the mixed color to behave in an unpredictable manner. You can therefore use any plastic, porcelain, or glass bowl if you don't have a special mixing bowl.
7. Applying the Formula in the Wrong Way

Nothing works when done in a messy way. Dying your hair is no exception. If you randomly move your brush and expect to have an even hair color, you're gonna get disappointed. Divide your hair into small sections and dye a small portion of strands each time and in the same direction.
8. Miscount the Processing Time

Have you ever cooked? If you overheat the food will be burnt and underheat will result in somehow raw and uncorked food. The hair is just like that. If you take too long or short time to dye your hair it'll either end up damaging your hair or not getting the color you wish you would.
9. Too Much Rinsing after Dying

If you immediately wash your hair after dying it and use too much warm water and shampoo to do so, all the work you have done would go to waste. Because the color pigments are not yet stable and move out from your hair. You don't want that.
10. Skip Post Treatment Process

This is a tricky one. You might think that dying your hair is enough to have a new look but it's not. Don't forget to do the post-coloring treatments to ensure that your hair color is stabilized. You better use a specific hair-colored conditioner and hair mask after rising your dyed hair.

posts.title: Our Continued Learning Journey: Exploring Business Opportunities in Manitoba, Canada
posts.author: Color Fluent
posts.brief: Color Fluent team receives Certificate of Attendance for participating in the insightful webinar 'Manitoba, Canada – Gateway to Business in North America,' exploring new horizons for global business expansion.

content.value: At Color Fluent, we believe that growth never stops — not for companies, nor for the people who make them thrive. That's why we are proud to share that our team recently received a Certificate of Attendance for participating in the insightful webinar "Manitoba, Canada – Gateway to Business in North America," held on October 28, 2021.

The session provided valuable insights into how Manitoba serves as a strategic hub for companies seeking to expand into the North American market. With its central geographic location, robust transportation infrastructure, and supportive business ecosystem, Manitoba has become an attractive entry point for organizations worldwide.

During the 90-minute webinar, industry leaders and government representatives highlighted key advantages of operating in Manitoba — from access to skilled labor and advanced logistics networks to competitive costs and a welcoming immigration environment. The discussion also shed light on how Canadian trade agreements can benefit global businesses looking to establish or expand operations in North America.

For our team at Color Fluent, attending this webinar was more than just an opportunity to learn; it was a step toward exploring new horizons. As a company that values innovation, global collaboration, and cultural fluency, we continuously seek ways to connect our expertise with emerging international opportunities. Manitoba's dynamic business landscape aligns well with our goals of creating cross-border partnerships and contributing to a more interconnected global marketplace.

Receiving this certificate is a reminder of our dedication to professional growth and our commitment to staying informed about global business trends. It also reflects our proactive approach to discovering new avenues where our services can make an impact — from supporting brand localization to facilitating meaningful connections between businesses and audiences worldwide.

We extend our appreciation to the organizers of the "Gateway to Business in North America" webinar for curating such an informative event. The knowledge gained reinforces our belief that education and engagement are powerful tools for shaping the future of international business.
At Color Fluent, we'll continue to invest in opportunities that expand our perspective, strengthen our partnerships, and empower us to bring global ideas to life.

posts.title: Celebrating Our Graduation from the Manitoba Technology Accelerator Startup Visa Program
posts.author: Color Fluent
posts.brief: Color Fluent officially graduates from the Startup Visa Program through the Manitoba Technology Accelerator, marking a significant milestone in our mission to build meaningful global connections through innovation.

content.value: We're thrilled to share a proud milestone in Color Fluent's journey — our official graduation from the Startup Visa Program through the Manitoba Technology Accelerator (MTA), awarded on March 1, 2023. This recognition marks a significant step forward in our mission to build meaningful global connections through innovation, creativity, and technology.

The MTA Startup Visa Program is designed to help international entrepreneurs establish and scale their businesses in Canada by providing mentorship, resources, and access to a thriving network of investors and industry experts. Through this program, our team gained invaluable insights into the Canadian business ecosystem, learned the essentials of scaling a startup in a competitive market, and built relationships that continue to shape our growth strategy.

Graduating from this program is not just an achievement — it's a validation of our vision and persistence. The experience challenged us to refine our business model, strengthen our operations, and prepare for sustainable expansion in North America. Under the mentorship and leadership of Marshall Ring, CEO of the Manitoba Technology Accelerator, we learned how to navigate the unique opportunities and challenges of entering the Canadian market with confidence and purpose.

For Color Fluent, this accomplishment represents the culmination of hard work, collaboration, and a shared belief in the power of innovation. We've emerged from the program with a clearer strategic direction, a stronger network, and a deeper understanding of how to position our company as a bridge between cultures and markets.

As we look ahead, we're excited to apply the lessons from the MTA Startup Visa Program to new projects and partnerships. Our goal remains to expand our global presence while staying true to our core values — creativity, inclusivity, and growth through learning.

We extend our sincere gratitude to the Manitoba Technology Accelerator team for their unwavering support and guidance throughout this journey. Their commitment to nurturing startups like ours plays a crucial role in shaping the future of entrepreneurship and innovation in Canada.
This certificate symbolizes more than completion — it celebrates new beginnings.

posts.title: Summer 2025: A Strategic Partnership Paving the Way for Smart Hair-Dyeing Technology
posts.author: Color Fluent
posts.brief: Color Fluent signs a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a strategic partnership for developing next-generation smart hair-dyeing solutions, combining advanced digital intelligence with material science.

content.value: Summer 2025 marks an exciting new chapter for Color Fluent — the beginning of a groundbreaking collaboration that's set to redefine the future of beauty technology. We're proud to announce that we have officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish a strategic partnership aimed at developing and launching next-generation smart hair-dyeing solutions.

This partnership represents the culmination of months of research, innovation, and shared vision between Color Fluent and our new collaborator — a technology leader whose expertise perfectly complements our creative and scientific strengths. Together, we're combining advanced digital intelligence, material science, and design to create a smarter, safer, and more personalized hair-coloring experience.

The MOU signing signifies more than just an agreement — it's the official start of a collaboration built on mutual trust, innovation, and a shared mission to transform how people interact with beauty. By leveraging smart sensors, AI-driven color analytics, and adaptive dyeing systems, our goal is to empower users to achieve salon-quality results at home while minimizing waste, improving sustainability, and enhancing self-expression.

This partnership also aligns with our broader strategy to position Color Fluent at the intersection of technology, fashion, and sustainability. As we move into this new phase, our teams will focus on integrating proprietary color-matching algorithms and smart-device compatibility into the dyeing process, ensuring a seamless experience from formulation to finish.

With the collaboration now official, the next stop is clear — market launch. The development roadmap is underway, and our teams are preparing for pilot testing, regulatory assessments, and global rollout planning. We aim to introduce the first commercial version of our smart hair-dyeing technology in the coming year, setting a new benchmark for innovation in the beauty industry.

This achievement reflects Color Fluent's ongoing commitment to pushing creative boundaries and redefining what's possible through science and design. We're not just developing products — we're crafting experiences that empower individuality and promote confidence through color.
Stay tuned as we enter this exciting new phase. The future of smart beauty starts here — and we can't wait to share it with the world.
Next stop: Market Launch.
